= Tests and benchmarks dashboard
:toc: preamble
:toclevels: 3

Pons's test and benchmark evidence, described the way
https://github.com/hyperpolymath/proven-tests-and-benches[proven-tests-and-benches]
describes it: every test carries a *provenance tier*, and coverage over the
estate's category x aspect lattice is derived from the tests that actually
ran and passed, never from a claim.

== The three provenance tiers

[cols="1,4"]
|===
| Tier | Meaning

| Actually-Proven
| A machine-checked proof artefact discharges the obligation. Claiming this tier requires `proof`, a path listed in `proof_artifacts`. This repository has none, so no entry may claim it: the gate fails the claim rather than accepting it.
| Provisionally-Proven
| A real, executed, passing test discharges the obligation for the finite domain it covers, and `reason` records the assumption or limitation that keeps the claim provisional. This is the honest tier for an ordinary test suite.
| Unproven
| The obligation is acknowledged and not discharged. The entry contributes NO coverage, and `reason` says why. An Unproven entry is a declared gap, not a failure.
|===

== The declared lattice

Columns are the first two letters of each aspect; `#` means some entry in the
ledger occupies that (category, aspect) cell. An `Unproven` entry is a declared
gap and occupies no cell.

[NOTE]
====
This is the DECLARED map. The DERIVED map — the cells occupied by tests
that actually ran and passed — is computed at run time by
`tests/proven/check_test_provenance.sh`, written to
`build/proven-report.json` and published in the CI job summary. A suite
that is declared but did not run contributes nothing to the derived map,
and the gate fails the build when a suite that was supposed to run failed.
====

== Machine-checked proofs

None. This repository has no machine-checked proof artefact, so no entry
may claim the Actually-Proven tier: the gate fails such a claim rather
than accepting it. Every obligation here is discharged, if at all, by an
executed test — which is what Provisionally-Proven means.

== Harness

These are the gate's own machinery, not tests, and are excluded from the
inventory for that reason.

* `tests/proven/check_test_provenance.sh`
* `tests/proven/provenance_gate_test.sh`
* `tests/proven/render_dashboard.sh`
* `scripts/proven-bench/check-bench-regression.sh`
* `scripts/proven-bench/compute-bench-baseline.sh`
* `scripts/proven-bench/bench-stats.jq`
* `scripts/proven-bench/verify-upstream.sh`
